title: 新客户初次开发信-激光美容设备推荐
content:
Dear XX Team,

I've followed XX's growth since your IPO — a listed group running PicoWay, PicoCure, Thermage FLX, Ultherapy Prime, Onda, Oligio X and EndyMed across 20+ centers in Hong Kong, Macau, mainland China, Australia and Singapore. That's a serious commitment to original OEM units.

Looking at your menu, your energy-based work is strong on picosecond lasers, RF tightening and body contouring. One area where we see groups like yours occasionally consider a dedicated mid-tier workhorse is hair removal — your current laser hair removal likely runs on Alexandrite or IPL. A triple-wavelength diode (755/808/1064nm) with sapphire cooling gives better results on Fitzpatrick IV–V skin, which is common among your Hong Kong and Southeast Asian clients. That's our D-100.

Two other units that may fit as second-room options:

K2 — BroadBand Light for photofacial, redness and shallow pigment

Q7 — Q-Switched Nd:YAG (1064/532nm) for deeper pigmented lesions and tattoo removal

We're not asking XX to replace your flagship brands — just leaving the spec sheets with your purchasing team in case there's a fit for a second-room unit or a refresh cycle.

Happy to send:

S500 / IPL-200 / NDYAG-300 specification sheets

Short operation videos (handpiece, screen flow, cooling tip)

If it's useful, keep them on file. If not, no follow-up needed.

Best regards,

Demo User

DemoMed – Medical Aesthetic Equipment
